warnings.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-East
warnings.description: Maximum wind speed : from 50 to 70 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break smaller branches.
warnings.instruction: Doors and windows should be kept closed. We recommend additional caution in traffic, especially in crosswinds and in exposed areas (e.g. bridges, cuttings). Do not linger in potentially dangerous areas.

warnings.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / Sea
warnings.description: Maximum wind speed : from 70 to 85 km/h. Sea heaps up and white foam from breaking waves begins to be blown in streaks along the direction of the wind. The sea is fairly rough (3).
warnings.instruction:
Before the event:
Caution at sea is recommended. Prepare necessary procedures and equipment in case of rapid deterioration of weather. Check the situation of vessels in berths.

During the event:
Less skilled sailors should not go out to sea. Swimmers should stay close to the shore. We recommend caution when practicing water sports.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of LIGHT SNOWFALL
warnings.description:
There is a risk of light snowfall (level 1 of 4).
Height range: > 1000 m; Precipitation amounts: < 10 cm; in windward areas: < 20 cm
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) to expect: slippery ground. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
Adapt your behaviour in road traffic (snow/icy surfaces, possibly reduced visibility).
